name: Disable Auto Proxy Detection
description: Disables automatic proxy discovery for your user to stop background checks that can delay connections on networks without a manual proxy.

description_i18n.en: Disables automatic proxy discovery for your user to stop background checks that can delay connections on networks without a manual proxy.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die automatische Proxy-Erkennung für Ihren Benutzer, um Hintergrundprüfungen zu stoppen, die Verbindungen auf Netzwerken ohne manüllen Proxy verzögern können.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la découverte automatique du proxy pour votre utilisateur afin d'arrêter les vérifications en arrière-plan qui peuvent ralentir les connexions sur des réseaux sans proxy manuel.

warnings.title: Managed network impact
warnings.message: Do not use this on corporate, school, or managed networks that rely on automatic proxy discovery. Disabling it may prevent your system from finding the required proxy configuration

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the AutoDetect DWORD value in HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings to disable automatic WPAD/proxy discovery for the current user
